collectibles.coupling: none required; the same wire is the original's main roof access to the valve (absolutcheats), so tape and drain share a line; fountain below is water or drained
collectibles.failure: fall into the fountain bowl (≈ 2-3 m below the plaza) or onto the steps; back on the planter in ≈ 5-10 s
collectibles.timeFromSpawnS: LP2 run 2: tape at 0:55 (≈ 65 s, after draining the fountain at 1:39 and the Telephone Co. Gap); dedicated segment ≈ 16 (1:11 -> 0:55); wire -> tape ≈ 4; inferred direct ≈ 20-25
collectibles.why: The tape hangs on the level's signature line above its centrepiece: discovery is easy, execution (commit to a long uphill wire grind high over a pit) is the test; mid-span placement makes the grind itself the challenge, and the line doubles as the roof access for the drain goal

guidance: The long wire leads the eye from the planter, over the fountain, to a roof; the tape glows on it above the busiest space (thumbsticks: follow the wire to its source)
B4 at the curved planter's tip puts the player on the wire's launch point before the tape is sought
Fountain jets and the red THPS sign are visible from spawn and pull the player to the centre under the wire
The skatepark unlock is shown by consequence: telephone poles fall across the fence; fence and white pillars hint at a hidden space
Hidden on purpose: the skatepark (until the poles fall) and the valve on the balcony
designLogic: The tape hangs over the centrepiece; challenge is execution (balance, commitment), fitting career level 7
Mid-span placement (≈ 2/3 along the wire) makes the sustained grind the test
One line serves two goals: the wire is the original's main route to the valve roof
Two directions: grind up from the planter (LP2, PS12) or down from the roof (RPGC)
A small skill step first: ollie onto a raised grass planter and ride its top
Cheap failure: a fall lands in the fountain bowl a few seconds from the planter (≈ 10 s retry)
The wire family is taught in the same level: overhead line (unlock), telephone wire (exit), long wire (tape)
State change as reward: draining turns the water feature into a rail arena and releases floor cash
The secret area (Phillyside) holds a goal list item and $850, not the tape
Bells and letters sit on basic features in one loop from the start (counter-clockwise on the VG image)
Feature reuse: the awning carries the K, the Bluntside goal, a bell and a 500-point gap
Cash scales with demand; the tape ($2000) is a mid-value goal here
The roof network loops (wire/balcony chain up; telephone wire, railing-to-planter or drop down)
remakeChanges: Tape unchanged: mid-wire over the fountain, reached from the planter end (PS12; thumbsticks; halfglassgaming)
Remake stacks a street stat point at the tape spot and the VV logo on the roof at the wire's top
Valves: LP2 shows one wheel on the balcony; PS12 describes three valves (grind one)
Skatepark unlock unchanged (blue handrail -> wire -> poles fall)
Bells renamed Liberty Bells in the goal; High Combo 40,000 added
Gap names: Hobo Grind -> Hobo Gap; Planter Double Pillar Hop -> ... Gap; THPS Fountain Gap -> THPS Statue Gap; World's Second Most Obvious Gap missing from PS12
Look: overcast PS1 plaza vs bright autumn daylight with dense trees (LP12)
transfer: Rising wire over a pit: a 30-40 m sloped rail/rope from a ≈ 1 m planter tip up to a ≈ 7 m roof across a sunken pool; crystal ≈ 60% along, ≈ 5 m above ground; add a mid-span break needing a grind ollie (≈ 2.4 m pop) or make it a snapping rope so the rider must keep moving
Shared roof chain: the rope ends at a roof whose balcony holds a trick-gate switch that drains the pool and reveals rails and a bonus
Teach the launch point first: a minor pickup at the planter tip where the rope starts
Two directions: a second roof route (stair rail -> kicker -> planter -> balcony ledge, or an on-foot ledge grab <= 2.4 m) so the crystal can also be taken grinding down
Wire that changes the world: grinding an overhead line drops poles (moving objects) that flatten a fence and open a vert park
Cheap retry under a visible target: crystal over the busiest space, launch planter a few seconds from any fall
